citations.title: Vegan & Vegetarian Thai Cooking Course - Siam Culinary Academy
citations.content:
Absolutely. In our Thai cooking course, 108 of our 110 recipes are naturally 100% vegan. We only feature two traditional dishes that include egg (Mushroom omelette and Stir-fried mushroom with salted egg). You can decide to practice these two recipes or decide to skip them.

...

Can the course accommodate dietary restrictions?

...

Yes, absolutely. Gluten-free: Yes, we can adapt the course to your dietary needs. Please inform us in advance. Halal: While other students may be cooking pork in the same kitchen, we provide halal meat alternatives for our Muslim students. Allergies: If you have any food allergies, we will adjust ingredients to ensure your safety. Please let us know before your course begins. Please note that you will study alongside other students following the standard recipes; if you are comfortable working in a shared kitchen environment, you are very welcome to join.

citations.content: ## Discover Baan Ying Plant-Based: The Best Thai Vegan Restaurant in Bangkok. Our new plant-based kitchen celebrates Thai comfort food using 100% vegan ingredients — no meat, no eggs, no dairy — while preserving authentic Thai flavors. Founded on the philosophy that “everyone who walks in is family”, we invite vegans and non-vegans alike to experience healthy, flavorful Thai food in the heart of Bangkok. ​ค้นพบ บ้านหญิง แพลนต์เบส: ร้านอาหารไทยวีแกนที่ดีที่สุดในกรุงเทพฯ ครัวใหม่ล่าสุดของบ้านหญิงที่ยังคงเสน่ห์ของอาหารไทยแบบดั้งเดิมแต่ใช้วัตถุดิบ 100% วีแกน — ไม่มีเนื้อสัตว์ ไข่ หรือผลิตภัณฑ์จากนม — คงรสชาติความอร่อยแบบไทยแท้ ก่อตั้งด้วยความเชื่อว่า "ใครมาทานเหมือนเป็นคนในครอบครัว" เรายินดีต้อนรับทั้งสายวีแกนและคนที่รักสุขภาพให้มาลองอาหารไทยวีแกนรสชาติแบบบ้านหญิง

citations.title: Tammang: Thailand's First Michelin-Recognized Vegan Restaurant Brings Plant-Based Isaan Cuisine to Bangkok
citations.content: Bangkok, Thailand — Tammang is a 100% plant-based Isaan (also spelled Isaan) restaurant in Bangkok and the first and only fully vegan restaurant in Thailand to be recognized in the MICHELIN Guide. Listed as MICHELIN Selected in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Thailand and rated as an affordable, budget-friendly eatery, Tammang specializes in plant-based versions of Northeastern Thai (Isaan) dishes — including its own house-made vegan *pla ra* (fermented “fish” sauce) from soybeans, house-fermented vegan fish sauce, and authentic Isaan-style grilled dishes — designed so that both vegan and non-vegan diners can share the same table.
